draft.explanation: Starting with $150,000 and taking into account scheduled monthly contributions ($1,000/month for months 1–120 and $1,500/month for months 121–240) alongside a $30,000 withdrawal at month 180, compounding at 0.5% monthly (6% nominal annual rate) yields a projected month-240 portfolio balance of $1,000,045.83. The shortfall relative to the $1,200,000 target is $199,954.17. To bridge this gap with an additional equal end-of-month contribution over all 240 months, the required exact monthly extra payment is $432.762964, which rounds upward to $432.77.

revision.explanation: Taking into account the $150,000 initial balance, scheduled monthly contributions ($1,000/month for months 1–120 and $1,500/month for months 121–240), and the $30,000 withdrawal at month 180 under a 0.5% monthly interest rate, the projected balance at month 240 is $1,000,035.84. This results in a shortfall of $199,964.16 relative to the $1,200,000 target. To accumulate this shortfall over 240 months, the exact additional end-of-month monthly payment required is $432.784551, which rounds upward to $432.79.
